subject: indiv-td
title: (R)INDIV.TD.------MT.INFO.
description: Diagram in CMOA(I)-5 (Creative Music Outside of America, Level One — Britain/Germany/Holland) accompanying Braxton's analysis of the post-Coleman impact in Europe: 'the emergence of the post-Coleman/Coltrane/Taylor junction of black creativity would have a profound effect on the composite nature of earth creativity — and this is no less true for what it would imply in Europe.' (R)INDIV-TD (the reality of individual tendencies) is crossed with MT-INFO (multi-information): the question is what individual-tendencies produces in its actual instantiation when crossed with multi-information — the (R) prefix marking that the post-Coleman moment elicited *real* individual-tendencies, not styled ones, and the crossing with multi-information is what made European audiences receptive. PROG-CONT (progressional continuance) branches from the main line to the upper-right. A long line from the main line runs down-left to INFO-AF-B (information affinity basis), which carries SOC-RT (social reality) and VT-DY (vibrational dynamics). SOC-RT carries DYM-F (dynamic functionalism) and AFI(2) (affinity insight—second degree), from which RT-ALGN (reality alignment) hangs at the lower-left. VT-DY carries EXP-DY (expansion dynamics) on the right margin, and AFI(1) (affinity insight—first degree) hangs from EXP-DY.
